blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Detained Sen. Rodante Marcoleta on Tuesday explained the Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC)’s silence over his imprisonment, saying that the Church’s lack of reaction or comment must not be construed as “indifference, weakness, or diminished resolve.” According to the senator, “the INC is under no obligation to publicly react to, or even comment on, the deprivation of my liberty simply because the matter is now pending before the courts of law.” “Any open pronouncement must yield to orderly administration of justice and proper resolution of the case through established judicial procedures,” he added in a statement posted on his […]...
